headline: Indonesia Stocks Lower at Close, IDX Composite Down 1.48%
summary: Indonesian stocks moved lower at the close of trade, with the IDX Composite Index dropping 1.48%.

impacts.name: IDX Composite
impacts.why: Broad selling pressure across listed Indonesian equities pulls the headline composite index lower.

why_moved: Broad-based selling across local sectors dragged down the main Indonesian stock index by the end of the trading session.
